name: vercel-deploys
description: A /vercel-deploys pane of your recent Vercel deployments: state, environment, branch, commit, creator, age and URL, with the current git branch highlighted

team.title: Vercel team
team.description: Vercel team id (team_...) or slug. Empty uses the team in .vercel/project.json, else your personal account.

project.title: Vercel project
project.description: Vercel project id or name to show. Empty uses the project linked in .vercel/project.json, else every project.

max_rows.title: Rows
max_rows.description: How many deployments to list, newest first.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the open pane refreshes while nothing is building.

building_refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval while building (seconds)
building_refresh_seconds.description: How often the pane refreshes while a deployment is building.

notify_on_finish.title: Toast when a branch deploy finishes
notify_on_finish.description: With the pane closed, keep watching deployments of the current git branch that were building and show a toast when each one is ready or fails.
